1. (Judgment 5) The featured slot puts 15th Club under "FEATURED," but the records mark Spaceman as the featured project. Spaceman then sits in "Selected Work," which the records build only from non-featured projects. Feature Spaceman, and list 15th Club, FishSticks and dougmar.ch as selected work.
2. (Judgment 5) The 15th Club description "Caddies read a course in seconds… turns a round's worth of shot data into the single number that changes the club already in your hand" is not in the records. The records describe it as "a platform for AI experiments through the lens of golf. The scorecard is the first experiment — shareable, real-time, no app install required." The link "Visit 15thclub.com" is also wrong: the record's liveUrl is 15th.club.
3. (Judgment 5) The role line reads "DESIGN & ENGINEERING," but the identity record's role is "Product Designer & Developer." Use the recorded role.
4. (Judgment 2) At 1440 the role line overruns the spruce spine: "ENGINEERING" runs past the rail edge into the lime field, and its final letter is clipped. The header crop shows this. Set the role line so it stays inside the rail, by wrapping it, using a smaller step, or widening the rail toward the declared 184px.
5. (Judgment 6) SHELL `ground_material: rule` is not visible on the hero field. The lime field reads as a flat fill, with only the single section break below it. Lay the declared ruled material across the hero field, keeping the hero word and deck clear of it.
6. (Judgment 6) `nav_form: list` declares a stacked list with one rule per row. The rail adds 01/02/03 prefixes, which belong to the `numbered` form. Drop the numerals so the nav reads as the declared list.

1. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman feature reads "Spaceman is where I first took a product from nothing to shipped — the founding chapter that set the pattern for everything built since." The records say no such thing. Spaceman is the LLC Doug has operated under for the past decade, partnering with companies and studios on product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand. Replace this with copy drawn from the record's approach and outcome.
2. (Judgment 6) SHELL declares `ground_material: rule`, but the lime hero field at 1440 and in fold 1 at 360 is a flat fill with no ruled lines. Lay the declared rule material across the hero field, kept clear of the "detroit" word and its deck.

1. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman description says "taking on the parts a team can't staff and shipping them as if they were my own". The record has no such claim. It also calls Spaceman "the studio I've run", but the record says "the LLC I've operated under for the past decade". Rewrite the paragraph from the record's approach text: partnering with companies and studios across industries, with work spanning product design, frontend engineering, design systems and brand, sometimes solo and sometimes embedded in a larger team.

2. (Judgment 5) The footer quote "Two games, two finishes – the kind of weekend that makes a whole city feel bulletproof" is attributed to James Allen. It reads as written to fit tonight's hero, not as the signal's actual line. Set the quote exactly as it arrived in today's signals, or drop the attribution.
